Players Committee card image of [[Nar Shaddaa (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “'''Light Side:''' Force drain +1 here. Once per game, if your control, may take Han's Toolkit into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/narshaddaa_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 793bf65] (15 January 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
